1:_: Seif 1 — place. Meaning mavo or courtyard each according to its law, as written in siman 362 seif 14, Eruvin 11b, and therefore he mentions place which includes both of them, as written in seifim 12, 13, and 14:
2:א: In its fullness up to ten amot. Eruvin 9b — small at ten etc., and there shakla v'tarya of the dispute of R' Yehuda and the Sages regarding pasin — two or one for a small one; but a large one that is not in its fullness — or alternatively nothing; and likewise there 94a, 1 — it is stronger at ten etc.:
2:ב: With a pas etc., and if. There 12a, 1 — conclusion of the dispute of R' Yehuda and the Sages, and mishnah 16, 2 — every breach etc.:
2:ג: And likewise if it remained etc., or. Eruvin 10a, 1, and see Tosafos there s.v. and two. Or alternatively etc. And likewise if it remained from one side in the measure that is permitted — for we say there 94a — always at ten, and such as etc., and it is impossible from the side — even if something remained it is nothing; we need not from two sides:
2:ד: And all this in height. Eruvin 14b — let us say we learned anonymously etc., this is what it means — those etc., and there 12a, 1 — the Sages agree with R' Eliezer regarding pasin of courtyard etc., the halacha etc.:
2:ה: And even if there is not. There — we need not majority etc.:
2:ו: Until there be. For anything less than three no correction is required — there 5a, 1 — less than three etc., and see there Rashi:
2:ז: And if there is. As above — small etc., and there 94a, 1 — except with more etc., and mishnah 15b and 16a:
3:א: Seif 3 — that he place it in the opening. It appears to me:
3:ב: And it shall be. There in the Gemara:
3:ג: And from any material. The mishnah there:
3:ד: Provided that. Sukkah, and as written above:
3:ה: And even if he tied. Per R' Moshe 1, and specifically without knowledge — therefore specifically tied:
4:א: If there is. Eruvin 9b — for R' Chiyya taught etc.:
4:ב: Provided that. Tosafos there s.v. wall. However if etc.:
7:_: Seif 7 — lechi even. Eruvin 80b, 2, and per R' Moshe — lechi; but etc., he explained — but lechi even if crushing etc., even fragments and fragments of fragments. Hagahot Maimoniyot:
8:א: Seif 8 — and therefore they make. Tosafos there s.v. but. And R' Avraham etc.:
8:ב: Provided that he beware. Hagahot Maimoniyot there, and as written there in the Gemara 14b:
9:_: Seif 9 — opposite the hollow. As written in the baraita of R' Chiyya — wall etc., and as Rashi wrote there, and they brought proof from that which we say 'those entering — walls etc.,' and if it is not required opposite the hollow — they themselves would be lechi:
10:_: Seif 10 — even though there is not in it. Yerushalmi chapter 1 brought a wall of seven and a mashehu, and they raised it from the ground less than three — permitted etc., anything less than three is as closed; and in the Gemara 16b — such as if he brought a mat etc.:
11:_: Seif 11 — such as when there was etc. Rashi there, and like the incident of Rav there:
12:א: Seif 12 — lechi standing etc., and if he placed it. Rashi there:
12:ב: Somewhat thick or. Per the second explanation of Rashi, and so too Rif:
13:א: Seif 13 — that he placed. Meaning even if he placed for the sake of lechi — as Shulchan Aruch, and per Rashbag it should be as visible etc., and see Rashi there; and furthermore from what is written 'Shmuel — three' and 'lechi — four,' and Tosafos there 5b, 2 s.v. less etc.:
13:ב: That its tip is not. Rashi:
13:ג: And he uses etc. These are exactly the words of the Mechaber according to the Gemara, and it is in Beit Yosef. And this requires further study, for we say there 'Shmuel — between etc.,' and we hold that between two lechayim is permitted; and already Bach wondered about this and explained Magen Avraham that here it deals when the walls are equal, and the Gemara deals when one side is long and the lechi extends opposite it — and these are the words of Ritva, and he said thus in his chiddushim: Rashi explained that the lechi etc., and the wording is difficult — why did they call it 'lechi extending with the side of the mavo,' and it appears that one wall of the mavo was long and this was short, and he added onto the short this lechi until it extends opposite the entire length of the long wall — and this is what we learn, that between two lechayim is forbidden, for if this lechi exceeds the wall opposite it — according to his words it is forbidden to use opposite it, for there is only one partition; and the wording 'lechi extending with the side of the mavo' means extending on this wall that was placed along the entire length of the other wall of the mavo opposite it that was long etc., see there. But Magen Avraham's words are strained and not settled, for Shulchan Aruch cites the Gemara's wording as it is, and also the plain meaning of the Gemara implies the walls are equal; and it would appear to me at first glance to say that the Mechaber explains that also the Gemara deals in this manner, except Rav Yosef holds the teaching as these — in a mavo whose one side is long, he places opposite the short and uses diagonally, as written in Yerushalmi there 'he places the korah diagonally and uses diagonally,' and as written in seif 30, and so Rashi explained; but for us, since we hold like Rava who follows his approach that concludes in Beit Yosef there that likewise lechi is forbidden — and so too in Rosh and Tur that they permitted only tzurat hapetach; except Rosh is not proof that he wrote according to Rava who holds lechi is also for recognition, as written 15a, 1; but we hold like Abbaye there, and Tur wrote because tzurat hapetach helps even in more than ten; but in the Gemara they said explicitly that even korah would be permitted if one holds korah is for partition — and so wrote Bach; and accordingly what Rif wrote is resolved: 'and if there is in the diagonal more than ten' — according to his words he does not place except opposite the short because of lechi; and resolves what R' Yehonatan and Rosh challenged on him — I could have numbered thus, but it is not so, for we say there that they dispute whether korah is for partition or recognition; but for lechi we hold it is for partition — indeed Beit Yosef follows his approach who holds that lechi on one long side does not help — and deals with seif 31 in Taz and Magen Avraham, as above. But still the sugya is not settled that Shmuel said between two lechayim is forbidden, as above. But it appears that even one lechi helps in this case and one uses diagonally — and this is what Shmuel said etc., and with this is resolved that Abbaye and Rava dispute between two lechayim, and Abbaye does not say 'from where do I know from this of Rav Yosef,' and he did not challenge Rava; but with this Rava is resolved who holds lechi is for recognition — it is not proven that he holds that also for lechi he does not place except etc.; unlike Abbaye; but we hold like Abbaye in this of one hundred thirty-five laws, as above, and therefore Rif and Rosh omitted stam Rama's gloss on this law, for the distinction between four amot or less is included in the general category of protruding lechi etc. However with this one may resolve the words of Shulchan Aruch in our time that are open to karmelit, and this is what Magen Avraham said, and see there seif 30, meaning that there it writes that lechi does not help on one long side etc. according to Beit Yosef. And siman 365 seif 4 means that there it writes 'and this is when open' etc.:
14:_: Seif 14 — and it is required. There 15a, 1 — twice in lechi etc., and in korah that everyone holds it is for recognition, as written 12b:
16:_: Seif 16 — this korah therefore. Rambam, and he intended the first explanation of Tosafos there s.v. but etc., and so too Maggid Mishneh:
17:א: Seif 17 — and its thickness. Eruvin 3a, 1 — they are made etc.:
17:ב: Only. Per the first Tanna and Rav, and as they wrote:
18:א: Seif 18 — that are not. For otherwise they themselves would be judged as korah, as written siman 25:
18:ג: Some say. Per R' Chiyya who is lenient on Rosh HaShanah, as written in Shabbat chapter 2, 1:
18:ד: And some say. Per the words of the lenient one among the scribes:
18:ה: And there is no between this. And so too Maggid Mishneh according to Rambam, as above siman 21, and what he wrote for its width a tefach that both of them together be a tefach wide:
22:_: Seif 22 — and some say that it is required. So explained Ritva, and he said thus: if they receive a brick for its width a tefach — this certainly does not come to teach us that both of them rise to one, for even of straw and of many reeds only that it be healthy; rather etc. that they receive the brick for its width in the air between them a tefach and a finger in this one and a finger in that one — and Rashbag validated even air of two tefachim and a half and a finger in this one etc., see there; and so is the view of Tosafos there s.v. provided. And two korot that fit etc., and see Tosafos in Sukkah 22b s.v. this one:
23:א: Seif 23 — if it was. Per R' Yehuda there, for we challenge from it to Rava in Sukkah 22 there s.v. like him, and from that the Gemara brings it there:
23:ב: And it shall not be. Sukkah there:
23:ג: And not in length. Rambam, and as above:
23:ד: And there are those who disqualify. For we do not hold like R' Yehuda who holds like his father. Rosh there, and what the Gemara brought it there — Ritva explained that according to the one who holds we see, we say yachbot; and in this the Sages do not disagree; and see Tosafos there s.v. provided, and not like Magen Avraham:
24:א: Seif 24 — but if. There — for it is covered implies that without this it is valid even though it extends. So too Rosh, and he rejected the words of Rashba. And to me it appears as the words of Rashba who explained that if it extends it is invalid, as written explicitly in the Gemara there 3b — its hollow ten, and what he wrote that it is covered deals above ten and is invalid because it is covered and there is also no partition, for it is not a partition that goats etc. And the difficulty of Rosh is removed:
26:א: Seif 26 — except with tzurat hapetach. So wrote Maggid Mishneh that less than nineteen is no partition at all, and all the more tzurat hapetach. And I wonder more that tzurat hapetach wrote in siman 362 seif 11 that the reeds must be nineteen high, and the implication of the wording is that the entire mavo is less than nineteen — and it is very difficult what tzurat hapetach helps, and even if it is entirely closed it is karmelit, as written in Shabbat 7b — house etc., and this requires further study; but in Rambam it writes the height of the opening, and it must be that tzurat hapetach be nineteen high, and nevertheless lechi of the opening of the mavo does not help since there is no measure of mavo as one who is not — unlike tzurat hapetach; and what he wrote in its length less than four amot — tzurat hapetach, Magen Avraham, and so too in Hagahot Alfasi chapter 1 s.v. and it is not required — houses, courtyard correction suffices, and see seif 32, and all this etc.:
26:ב: In the height of its hollow. Eruvin 3b:
26:ג: But it is permitted. Eruvin 11a, 1, and see there Tosafos s.v. the reverse:
26:ד: That he make in it. There, and per the explanation of nests — shape of dove nests and the like — Maggid Mishneh, and chapter per R' Moshe — nests according to his approach everywhere that they said according to the one who says etc., and according to the one who says etc., like the other:
26:ה: And he built a structure. So explained Ri and Maggid Mishneh the wording of Rif and Rambam that wrote he places a korah, and so too in Yerushalmi he makes a projection on the opening of a mavo etc.:
26:ו: In a wide building etc. From what Rif wrote he reduces it with a korah a tefach wide, and Rosh challenged him; but he explained in this manner, and so too in Tosefta — how does he do it, he places the korah etc.:
26:ז: Must carve. Like Abbaye whose sugya follows him there 11a:
26:ח: On the face of. Rosh there, not like Rif and Rambam:
26:ט: And two houses. Shabbat 131a, 1 — end of seif — house there is etc.:
26:י: And there are those who disagree. Rif who explained like Rav, and the first version — because they said Rav does not teach forty, for it is individual; and even though Rav for his reason etc., in this he does not hold like him that open ones they make for them one courtyard, and like anonymous mishnah:
26:כ: And that. Eruvin 5a, 1, and per Rashi s.v. and if etc.:
26:ל: And that they etc. eat. Eruvin 2b:
26:מ: That the place. There, and like Rav 3a, 1:
26:נ: Even though the son. See Tosafos there s.v. like Rabbi. And he brings proof etc., and so too in the Gemara from that which it says and it is not required to combine:
26:ס: And even its side. Gemara 76a, 1, and see Tosafos 2b s.v. mavo. And one may ask — even etc., and furthermore for what etc.:
26:ע: It is not permitted except. There 12b, and the aforementioned Tosafos, and one may say that with tzurat hapetach etc., for whoever has no mavo correction has the law of a courtyard, as written:
26:פ: For all the mavo'ot. Magen Avraham in the name of Terumat HaDeshen, and see seif 31:
27:_: Seif 27 — even though. Tosafos there s.v. and houses etc., and one may ask etc., and it appears to explain etc., and so too Hagahot Alfasi there:
28:א: Seif 28 — mavo that there is not etc. Eruvin 5a, 1, as above in seif 2:
28:ב: And some say per the words of the lenient one. And Rambam ruled like the second explanation according to his way everywhere, and since R' Eliezer is a Tanna and Shmuel holds not like him — thus we state it:
29:א: Seif 29 — and we are not concerned. As the version of R' Chiyya — we are not concerned etc., and the mavo'ot were open and it stopped at Ozel to another side not at the place of the sea, because it was easy to remove them; and what he wrote 'and the Sages forbid because of garbage.' Maggid Mishneh:
29:ב: And there are those who disagree. As the version of Rashi:
30:א: Seif 30 — but if. There, and I will say the reason etc., but tzurat hapetach — according to his words because of partition, and see there 11a, 1:
30:ג: And within the mavo. See Rashi s.v. diagonally etc.:
30:ד: And he uses etc. Yerushalmi — he places the korah diagonally and uses diagonally:
31:א: Seif 31 — he placed a lechi. There 14b:
31:ב: If there is. Eruvin 59b, and see there Tosafos s.v. mavo etc.:
31:ג: And the outer ones also made. Rosh in the name of Yerushalmi, and see there:
31:ד: But if they made. There 10a, 1, and if to permit it for a large one etc., and see there Tosafos s.v. and two etc.:
32:ב: From here onward. Here he ruled explicitly that in less than four amot courtyard correction suffices:
33:א: Seif 33 — and one must beware. Rosh in the name of Yerushalmi, and as written in the Gemara 9a, 1:
33:ב: And what is from the pas. Tosafos there s.v. he makes etc., and even though Tosafos wrote more than ten — that is according to Shmuel, and as Tosafos wrote there:
33:ג: And some say. So too Rosh and Tur, and wrote in Darkei Moshe that in less than this he relies on the explanation of Ritza in Tosafos there:
33:ד: Ten amot. It must read more than ten:
34:א: Seif 34 — or he distances an amah. Gemara there — there is not likewise etc.:
34:ב: Or he distances two etc. There 'Shmuel — standing as breached is permitted forever etc.,' behold the majority is permitted:
34:ג: Provided that. And as above 'Shmuel — standing as breached etc.':
34:ד: And one must beware. There, and one should be concerned etc.:
34:ה: Seif 34 — unless. Tzurat hapetach. For even from four sides it helps there 11a, and they are not concerned, and even for Tosafos and Rosh who forbid in a valley from one side — they concede as above in siman 362:
35:א: Seif 35 — this pas. Yerushalmi — anything less than three is as closed, as written in seif 10, and from what is written Eruvin 16b — if we establish it above etc., if we establish etc., it has standing etc.; but if it stands from one side in this manner — four amot — even though it is through less than three, and see Tosafos in Sukkah 16b s.v. in less etc., and one may wonder etc., and one may say etc., and we do not hold except for an individual all his needs:
